Hy all 

let's say i have a first data set, 100 item with 1000 respondens. 
i already done the IRT test with 2pl for these 100 item. i had discriminant, and difficulty for each item


if i have a second data set, let's say 95 item with 1000 respondens
i want to find item discriminant and item difficulty for 95 item of second data set using 5 item as anchor form first data set

how to do that with mirt package? can you help me with the syntax?

i appreciate any help from you guys 
thanks

messages.subject: Re: estimate new data set's parameter using anchor
parts:
You want to fix the parameters for your 95 items to their previous estimates, then calibrate the remainder of the test holding those items constant. You can probably do this best by passing 

sv <- mirt(..., pars = 'values')
sv # edit this object, setting est to FALSE where applicable
mod <- mirt(..., pars = sv)

This question has come up a few times on this forum, so feel free to look through the previous questions for other advice. HTH. 

Phil
